Based on information currently available, we expect our total organic capital investments for 2026 , net of contributions from noncontrolling interests, to approximate $3.5 to $3.8 billion, which reflects organic growth capital investments of $2.9 to $3.2 billion and sustaining capital expenditures of $580 million.

In addition, we expect approximately $600 million in cash proceeds from asset sales and other matters during 2026, primarily from the second installment payment received in January 2026 related to the sale of a 40% undivided joint interest in our Bahia NGL Pipeline, which may be used to offset a portion of our forecasted organic growth capital investments.
